query: SELECT p.id, p.vendaId, p.numeroParcela, p.valor, p.dataVencimento, p.okConsultor, v.clienteNome FROM parcelas p JOIN vendas v ON p.vendaId = v.id WHERE v.clienteNome LIKE '%Teste%' OR v.clienteNome LIKE '%Parcelado%' ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 10;
